description: data.london.gov.uk: transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in London Datastore, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.london.gov.uk. Coverage: the area served by data.london.gov.uk. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Just transition initial analysis by industry group in London; Bus Use and Supply Data 1999-2022; Ealing residential pipeline. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence v2, Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-london-datastore.
